_readme: Single source of truth for the Teaming page AND the capability statement PDF. Edit here, then run `node scripts/build-capability-statement.mjs` to regenerate public/sudden-north-capability-statement.pdf. Empty identifier values are hidden everywhere.
name: Sudden North

naics.title: R&D in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences

summary: Sudden North is a veteran-led engineering firm delivering secure software, cybersecurity, systems integration, and hardware prototyping. We give prime contractors and program offices a small, accountable team that understands defense delivery from requirements and estimates through test and sustainment.

competencies.title: Software engineering
items: Full-stack web, mobile, and cloud applications

differentiators.title: Defense program experience
differentiators.text: Founders have led, estimated, and proposed multimillion-dollar defense software efforts on strategic and airborne electronic warfare programs.

differentiators.title: Engineering and business fluency
differentiators.text: Senior software and electrical engineering leadership paired with MBA-level cost, schedule, and proposal discipline.

differentiators.title: Security in the foundation
differentiators.text: Cyber is designed into the architecture and delivery pipeline, not inspected in at the end.

differentiators.title: Small and accountable
differentiators.text: Direct access to the founders, clear ownership, and visible progress from the first week.

teamingRoles.title: Specialty subcontractor
teamingRoles.text: Defined software, cyber, or systems workshare inside your program, staffed by senior engineers who need little ramp-up.

teamingRoles.title: Proposal & pursuit partner
teamingRoles.text: Technical volume support, solution architecture, and bottom-up estimates from people who have written them.

teamingRoles.title: Surge & specialty capacity
teamingRoles.text: Focused help when a program needs depth fast: modernization, integration, test, or security hardening.

teamingRoles.title: Prototype & R&D partner
teamingRoles.text: Rapid prototypes and technical validation that retire risk before a program commits to a full build.

founders.name: Shawn-Patrick Bland
founders.bio: Retired U.S. Navy veteran and senior software engineer with an MBA. Has developed, managed, estimated, and proposed multimillion-dollar defense software efforts.

founders.name: Ben Martin
founders.bio: Chief engineer with an electrical engineering background and deep experience in complex airborne defense systems.
